MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, meeting the Sector Strength threshold; leadership is Broad (4 sectors represented in the Top 5). The supplied regime stands despite broad sector gains: Communication is weak, major stocks show trend divergence, and leadership is not clearly Growth/Momentum or Value/Cyclical.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate leads on the 1W sector return (+3.09%); CCI (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +28.94%) is ABOVE TREND. Energy (+2.44%) and Healthcare (+2.36%) follow: XOM (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +14.91%) and LLY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +8.08%) are ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication is weakest (-3.21% 1W; -4.77% 1M), with NFLX (1W: -8.52% | 1M: -10.19%) and T (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary is down 0.43% 1W, with GM (1W: -7.78% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND; Technology’s sector average is positive, but GOOGL (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -7.89%) and META (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -16.11%) are BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: LMT (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%), DOW (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +21.31%), PANW (1W: +12.54% | 1M: +4.19%), NOW (1W: +8.82% | 1M: +16.63%) and SLB (1W: +8.13% | 1M: +2.99%) are all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors across the Top 5); the supplied LMT upgrade and DOW margin-recovery headlines align with their rising prices.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMAT (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -20.08%), NEM (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -9.09%), FCX (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -9.69%), GE (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -11.69%) and GM (1W: -7.78% | 1M: -7.65%) are all BELOW TREND. Weakness spans Technology, Materials, Industrials and Consumer Discretionary rather than being confined to one group.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves among the leaders: LMT (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%), DOW (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +21.31%) and PANW (1W: +12.54% | 1M: +4.19%), all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: MSFT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +3.18%) and MA (1W: -0.47% | 1M: +8.24%) are in CORRECTION, while JPM (1W: +0.15% | 1M: -2.14%) and JNJ (1W: +4.93% | 1M: -1.81%) are in RECOVERY; watch for trend break.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: the sector average is +0.47% for 1W and +0.12% for 1M, while the provided data does not give positive constituent counts. PANW (1W: +12.54% | 1M: +4.19%) and NOW (1W: +8.82% | 1M: +16.63%) are ABOVE TREND, but AMAT (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -20.08%) and META (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -16.11%) are BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
The sector average is positive at +1.17% for 1W and +0.75% for 1M, though constituent breadth counts were not supplied. V (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +10.01%) is ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: +0.15% | 1M: -2.14%) is in RECOVERY and MA (1W: -0.47% | 1M: +8.24%) is in CORRECTION.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
The sector average is +2.36% for 1W and +5.02% for 1M; positive constituent counts were not supplied. LLY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +8.08%) and UNH (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.06%) are ABOVE TREND, while JNJ (1W: +4.93% | 1M: -1.81%) is in RECOVERY.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Stance?
Favor select strength across Industrials, Materials and Energy, while keeping exposure measured given the CAUTION regime and major trend divergence. PANW (1W: +12.54% | 1M: +4.19%), LMT (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%) and XOM (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +14.91%) are ABOVE TREND; style is mixed, with no clear Growth or Value leadership confirmation.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LMT (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%) and DOW (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +21.31%) are ABOVE TREND; monitor for follow-through after the upgrade and margin-recovery headlines, respectively. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -7.89%) and META (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -16.11%) are BELOW TREND; watch for stabilization after sustained weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate (+3.09% 1W), Energy (+2.44%) and Healthcare (+2.36%) lead on sector returns; constituent breadth counts are unavailable. BEARISH: Communication is weakest (-3.21% 1W; -4.77% 1M), while Consumer Discretionary is down 0.43% 1W; monitor whether weakness broadens.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels are not included in the supplied data. Monitor whether LMT (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%), ABOVE TREND, holds its advance; whether GOOGL (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -7.89%), BELOW TREND, stabilizes; and whether MSFT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +3.18%), in CORRECTION, resumes its monthly trend or weakens further.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LMT (+50): Morgan Stanley upgrade; LMT (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive catalyst. TSLA (+50): Megapack systems reportedly nearing sellout through 2027; TSLA (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +5.24%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming. DOW (+50): Q3 results point to margin recovery, but DOW also has a dividend-cut concern; DOW (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +21.31%) is ABOVE TREND, so price action currently confirms the positive headline mix.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-45): weak quarterly report; BA (1W: -1.62% | 1M: -4.93%) is BELOW TREND, confirming. NFLX (-40): concern over viewer engagement; NFLX (1W: -8.52% | 1M: -10.19%) is BELOW TREND, confirming. LRCX (-40): Citi target cut despite reported share gains; LRCX (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -24.65%) is BELOW TREND, confirming. GE (-40): price-target reduction; GE (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -11.69%) is BELOW TREND, confirming.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed with no clear Growth or Value leadership; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, and leadership is Broad (4 sectors across the Top 5). LMT (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +22.26%) and DOW (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +21.31%) are showing relative strength, both ABOVE TREND. Major divergence in MSFT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +3.18%), CORRECTION, and JPM (1W: +0.15% | 1M: -2.14%), RECOVERY, warrants confirmation; bearish sentiment and price weakness in NFLX (1W: -8.52% | 1M: -10.19%), BELOW TREND, add risk.
